articles.title: German Inflation Climbs To 3-Month High Amid Energy Price Surge
articles.expand: Consumer price inflation in Germany accelerated at a faster than expected pace in July to its strongest in three months as energy prices surged after the government's fuel tax rebate ended and also due to the intensification of the conflict in the Middle East. The inflation shoot up in the biggest euro area economy has raised the speculation regarding an interest rate hike in September.
